visualCharacteristics.structure: centered card: eyebrow + h1 + subtitle + CTA + timer note

contentPattern:
Row 1, 1 cell: eyebrow paragraph (e.g.

IN THE FIGHT AGAINST CANCER

), h1, subtitle paragraph (line breaks allowed), CTA paragraph with a bold link (primary button, e.g. 'Get started' -> /find-care/cancer-screening/assessment), note paragraph ':clock: 30 seconds'. Paragraphs before the heading are the eyebrow; paragraphs after the CTA, or with an icon, are the note. Row 2 (optional), 1 cell: alternate CTAs for returning visitors (bold link 'Retake', italic link 'Return to guide'); shown instead of the row 1 CTA when sessionStorage has 'quiz-results'. Section metadata style 'core' gives the blue surface around the white card.
